text: Claims_clean is one trustworthy stream. This video builds the two Gold tables people actually use: a safe clinic summary, and a patient-level detail table.
claims_summary_gold aggregates to clinic and day -- total billed, claim count, denial rate, no patient fields at all. claims_detail_gold keeps patient_name and patient_ssn, one row per claim.
Because claims_summary_gold is grouped past the patient entirely, it ships safe the moment it's built -- there's no identifying data left to protect.
claims_detail_gold is correct, but as of this lesson it has zero access control -- anyone with SELECT sees every clinic's patients, the exact problem this project exists to fix.
Both tables are built and verified. Next: closing that exact gap with real Unity Catalog row-level security.
